This is the measurement card the #4229 ruling asked for, and its value is the recorded answer: one deliberate, three-layer-coordinated shape (re-verified on `origin/main` @ `9461dd3`: `METRIC_TYPES` at `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:313` carries all four names, `SINGLE_VALUE_CHART_TYPES` at `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts:102`), not four instances of #4229's missing-map-entry defect. Whether `gauge`/`bullet`/`kpi` should render true dials is an appetite question with no measured user pull today; the card correctly proposes no fix. Held on the record so the next "gauge renders as a number" report resolves here instead of re-measuring.

Concentrated finding round (unified triage seat, 2026-08-17): **closed not planned**. The card's own conclusion is that the measurement request is answered: the four types share ONE deliberate single-value path (spec calls them "honest single-value variants pending a real dial/target renderer"), and the number is the honest render — the pre-#2942 bar-shell was the defect. What remains is *building a dial/arc/bullet-target renderer*, which is a feature investment with no measured pull on record; per startup scope discipline that earns appetite before a queue slot, not a standing card. The answer this card exists to record is preserved here in the closed record.

Reopen trigger: a user/app actually needs gauge/bullet/kpi visuals (measured pull), or the maintainer allocates appetite for the renderer — reopen and route as a Feature, one piece of work covering all four types (radial gauge, bullet band, and the `kpi` disposition), per this card's "actual gap" section. Maintainer veto of this closure: reopen is free.
